description: A single-storey rear extension replacing an old conservatory, adding modern living space to a home in Felixstowe.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: Ms Cole asked Architecture ONE to replace the ageing conservatory at 26 Dovedale, Felixstowe, with a proper single-storey rear extension.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: The scheme involved demolishing the existing conservatory and building a single-storey rear extension in its place, designed to suit the local streetscape.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: East Suffolk Council granted full planning permission for the extension in May 2019 (application ref. DC/19/1274/FUL).
